name: Meoshi Kouta
source:
Although he may be a legend online, where he's earned the nickname "Ares" for his fighting game prowess, he is gloomy and defeatist IRL. Smart but in terrible shape, he can't manage physical activity for more than a minute or two. His familiarity with video games extends to most of the games the attractions are built on. Definitely not a scrub.

[From [url=http://sweet-fuse.com/]official website[/url]]
